name: MariaDB 12.3 LTS with phpMyAdmin and Backups
description: MySQL-compatible MariaDB LTS, tuned, with phpMyAdmin and daily backups.

upstream.mariadb: mariadb:12.3.3 (MariaDB Server 12.3.3, LTS series 12.3, GA 2026-05-28, community EOL 2029-06-12; image digest sha256:d46e102fa8b9b72bfcdeb56f9dd538742092119dc8b11f31fe662605cd234cd9, built 2026-10-26)
upstream.phpmyadmin: phpmyadmin:5.2.3-apache (phpMyAdmin 5.2.3 on PHP 8.3.36; image digest sha256:fb0cb638f7d1c2529407921d86679b2b2faf5bb8542314821e9f16e7e3d2954f, built 2026-10-28)

MariaDB.startCommand: /bin/bash -c 'set -e; F=/etc/mysql/conf.d/zz-railway.cnf; X=/tmp/zz-railway.cnf; k() { v=$1; if [ $v -lt $2 ]; then v=$2; fi; if [ $v -gt $3 ]; then v=$3; fi; echo $v; }; n() { case "$1" in ""|*[!0-9]*) echo $2 ;; *) echo $1 ;; esac; }; w() { echo "$1 = $2" >> $X; }; echo "# Railway template: rewritten at every boot from the DB_* variables; DB_EXTRA_ARGS overrides it" > $X; echo "[mariadbd]" >> $X; COL="${DB_COLLATION:-utf8mb4_unicode_ci}"; case "$COL" in utf8mb4_) COL=bad ;; utf8mb4_*[!a-z0-9_]*) COL=bad ;; utf8mb4_*) ;; *) COL=bad ;; esac; if [ "$COL" = bad ]; then echo "mariadb-tune: DB_COLLATION=${DB_COLLATION} is not a utf8mb4 collation name, using utf8mb4_unicode_ci"; COL=utf8mb4_unicode_ci; fi; w character_set_server utf8mb4; w collation_server $COL; if [ "$COL" != utf8mb4_uca1400_ai_ci ]; then w character_set_collations utf8mb4=$COL; fi; w max_allowed_packet 64M; w innodb_use_native_aio 0; w ignore_db_dirs lost+found; case "${DB_SLOW_QUERY_LOG:-off}" in on|ON|On|true|TRUE|True|yes|1) SLOW=on ;; *) SLOW=off ;; esac; if [ $SLOW = on ]; then LQT="${DB_LONG_QUERY_TIME:-2}"; case "$LQT" in ""|.|*[!0-9.]*|*.*.*) LQT=2 ;; esac; w log_output TABLE; w log_slow_query ON; w log_slow_query_time $LQT; fi; if [ "${DB_TUNING:-auto}" = off ]; then echo "mariadb-tune: DB_TUNING=off, MariaDB defaults apply to memory and connections"; else H=$(( $(n "$(grep -m 1 MemTotal /proc/meminfo | tr -s " " | cut -d " " -f 2)" 1048576) / 1024 )); L=$(cat /sys/fs/cgroup/memory.max 2>/dev/null || cat /sys/fs/cgroup/memory/memory.limit_in_bytes 2>/dev/null || echo max); M=$(( $(n "$L" $((H * 1048576))) / 1048576 )); if [ $M -gt $H ]; then M=$H; fi; B=$(k $(n "$DB_MEMORY_LIMIT_MB" $(k $M 256 8192)) 256 4194304); P=$(k $(n "$DB_BUFFER_POOL_MB" $(k $((B / 2)) 128 2097152)) 32 4194304); C=$(k $(n "$DB_MAX_CONNECTIONS" $(k $((B / 8)) 100 500)) 10 100000); T=$(k $((B / 64)) 16 64); w innodb_buffer_pool_size ${P}M; w innodb_log_file_size $(k $((P / 4)) 96 512)M; w max_connections $C; w tmp_table_size ${T}M; w max_heap_table_size ${T}M; w innodb_io_capacity 1000; w innodb_io_capacity_max 2000; echo "mariadb-tune: budget ${B}MB (container ${M}MB, host ${H}MB)"; fi; mkdir -p /etc/mysql/conf.d; install -m 644 $X $F; echo "mariadb-tune: $(grep -v "^#" $X | paste -sd " " -)"; set -f; exec docker-entrypoint.sh "$@" ${DB_EXTRA_ARGS:-}' mariadb-start mariadbd

MARIADB_ROOT_PASSWORD.description: Root password, generated at deploy (letters and digits, URL-safe). Used by the backup job. Changing it later needs ALTER USER as well.

MARIADB_DATABASE.description: Database created on first boot (the app database).

MARIADB_USER.description: App user created on first boot with all privileges on MARIADB_DATABASE only.

MARIADB_PASSWORD.description: App user password, generated at deploy. Changing it later needs ALTER USER as well.

MARIADB_URL.description: Private connection URL with the mariadb:// scheme (MariaDB Node.js/Python connectors).

MARIADB_PUBLIC_URL.description: Connection URL from outside Railway through the TCP proxy (egress is billed).

MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD.description: Same as MARIADB_ROOT_PASSWORD, under Railway MySQL's name.

MYSQL_DATABASE.description: Same as MARIADB_DATABASE, under Railway MySQL's name.

MYSQLHOST.description: Private hostname of this database (mariadb.railway.internal). Used by the Data panel and other services.

MYSQLUSER.description: User for the Data panel and the MYSQL_* URLs (the app user, not root).

MYSQLDATABASE.description: Default database for the Data panel and the MYSQL_* URLs.

MYSQL_URL.description: Private connection URL, same name and format as Railway MySQL. Reference it as ${{MariaDB.MYSQL_URL}}.

MYSQL_PUBLIC_URL.description: Connection URL from outside Railway through the TCP proxy, same name as Railway MySQL (egress is billed).

MARIADB_AUTO_UPGRADE.description: Run mariadb-upgrade (after a backup of the system tables) when the image version changes. Read by the image's entrypoint.

RAILWAY_DEPLOYMENT_DRAINING_SECONDS.description: Time MariaDB gets to shut down cleanly (flush InnoDB, save the buffer pool list) on redeploy.

DB_TUNING.description: auto = size buffer pool, redo log, connections and temp tables from the container memory limit at every boot; off = MariaDB defaults.

DB_MEMORY_LIMIT_MB.description: RAM the tuning plans for. auto = the container limit capped at 8192 MB; set a number after resizing the service.

DB_BUFFER_POOL_MB.description: InnoDB buffer pool in MB. auto = half of DB_MEMORY_LIMIT_MB (memory is used only as data is read).

DB_COLLATION.description: Server collation (charset is always utf8mb4). utf8mb4_unicode_ci works with every MySQL client; utf8mb4_uca1400_ai_ci is MariaDB's newer default.

DB_SLOW_QUERY_LOG.description: on = log queries slower than DB_LONG_QUERY_TIME to the mysql.slow_log table.

DB_LONG_QUERY_TIME.description: Slow query threshold in seconds (decimals allowed), used when DB_SLOW_QUERY_LOG=on.

DB_EXTRA_ARGS.description: Extra mariadbd options appended to the command line, space-separated (e.g. --sql-mode=TRADITIONAL). They override the tuning file.

phpMyAdmin.startCommand: /bin/bash -c 'set -e; n() { case "$1" in ""|*[!0-9]*) echo $2 ;; *) echo $1 ;; esac; }; E=/etc/apache2/mods-enabled; N=$(ls $E/mpm_*.load 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d " "); if [ "$N" -ne 1 ] || [ ! -e $E/mpm_prefork.load ]; then echo "pma-start: $N Apache MPM modules enabled, keeping mpm_prefork only"; rm -f $E/mpm_*.load $E/mpm_*.conf; a2enmod -q mpm_prefork; fi; W=$(n "$PMA_APACHE_WORKERS" 10); if [ $W -lt 2 ]; then W=2; fi; if [ $W -gt 256 ]; then W=256; fi; A=/etc/apache2/conf-enabled/zz-railway.conf; echo "ServerTokens Prod" > $A; echo "ServerSignature Off" >> $A; echo "<IfModule mpm_prefork_module>" >> $A; echo "StartServers 2" >> $A; echo "MinSpareServers 1" >> $A; echo "MaxSpareServers 4" >> $A; echo "ServerLimit $W" >> $A; echo "MaxRequestWorkers $W" >> $A; echo "MaxConnectionsPerChild 500" >> $A; echo "</IfModule>" >> $A; I="${PHP_INI_DIR:-/usr/local/etc/php}/conf.d/zz-railway.ini"; echo "display_errors = Off" > $I; echo "log_errors = On" >> $I; echo "expose_php = Off" >> $I; echo "pma-start: Apache prefork MaxRequestWorkers $W, PMA_HOST ${PMA_HOST:-unset}:${PMA_PORT:-3306}, root login ${PMA_ALLOW_ROOT:-false}"; exec /docker-entrypoint.sh apache2-foreground' pma-start

PORT.description: Port Apache listens on; the public domain and the healthcheck use it.

PMA_HOST.description: MariaDB host on the private network; phpMyAdmin is pre-connected to it.

PMA_ALLOW_ROOT.description: true allows the MariaDB root account to log in through the web UI. Keep false and log in as the app user unless you need server-wide admin.

PMA_APACHE_WORKERS.description: Maximum concurrent Apache/PHP workers (each up to MEMORY_LIMIT). Raise for many simultaneous users.

UPLOAD_LIMIT.description: Largest file the Import tab accepts (PHP upload and POST size).

MEMORY_LIMIT.description: PHP memory limit per request (imports and exports of large tables).

HIDE_PHP_VERSION.description: Do not send the PHP version in HTTP headers.

PMA_USER_CONFIG_BASE64.description: Template hardening for phpMyAdmin (root login switch, no empty passwords, no arbitrary servers, failed logins logged). Base64 of config.user.inc.php in the template repo; the image writes it at start.

BACKUP_DB_USER.description: Account used for the dumps; root is needed to read every database and the account list.

BACKUP_DB_PASSWORD.description: Password of that account (kept in sync by reference).

BACKUP_TLS.description: verify = TLS with MariaDB's password-based certificate check; require = TLS without the check; off = plain TCP (private network only).

BACKUP_S3_BUCKET.description: Railway Bucket that stores the backups.

BACKUP_S3_FORCE_PATH_STYLE.description: Keep false: Railway Buckets use virtual-hosted-style URLs. true only for buckets whose Credentials tab says path-style.

BACKUP_PREFIX.description: Folder in the bucket; each run writes {prefix}/{UTC timestamp}/.

BACKUP_DATABASES.description: Databases to dump, comma-separated. Empty = every database except information_schema, performance_schema, sys and mysql.

BACKUP_RETENTION_DAYS.description: Delete complete runs older than this many days.

BACKUP_KEEP_MIN.description: Always keep at least this many complete runs, whatever their age.

BACKUP_VERIFY.description: true = read each dump back from the bucket and check its zstd checksums and the mariadb-dump footer.

BACKUP_WAIT_SECONDS.description: How long a run waits for MariaDB to accept connections before failing.
